goal: Land ten serialised pull requests that all edit scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs as ONE combined branch, by merging every contributing branch in the published landing order so each author's commits and intent are preserved, resolving conflicts as a faithful union of all sides, and proving every contributed regression test still passes here and still fails against its own unfixed code.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues in this repository through to production
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, schema, function, view, role, grant or index change.
Never rebase, force-push or otherwise rewrite a contributing session's branch; every contributing branch is merged, never replayed.
Never drop a contributed fix, test or reviewed disposition to make a conflict easier; stop and report instead.
Do not weaken, disable or bypass any gate, check or review requirement; consolidation is one review of the combined content, never no review.
Never hand-delete a refs/db-review-active/* ref and never post a synthetic verdict.
No --admin merge on a code change.
assumptions: These ten pull requests ship no migration, so migration-author-lease.yml auto-authorizes them and the governed reviewer draw does not apply; operationRouting would in any case refuse a pull request that closes more than one work issue.

PR #3308 is actively worked by another session and is deliberately excluded; PR #3330 merged to main independently during this work and its content arrives through the base, so issue #2832 is not closed here.

The pre-partition aggregate throughput audit is frozen historical evidence that the equivalence test requires to match the partitioned catalogues exactly, so PR #3338's one new call-site disposition is registered in both, byte-identical.
stop_conditions: Stop if combining would lose any contributed fix, test or reviewed disposition.
Stop if any contributed regression test cannot be shown to fail against its own unfixed code.
Stop if landing this would require weakening a gate, check or review requirement.
Stop if a rate limit makes any state read unreadable; an empty or failed answer is never evidence of state.
